name: Git Configuration
description: Configures git with user settings, signing keys, plugins, and global gitignore

provider.description: Git provider to configure default settings for (to be implemented)

userName.description: Git user.name value. Falls back to GIT_USER environment variable if not set.

userEmail.description: Git user.email value. Falls back to GIT_EMAIL environment variable if not set.

signingKey.description: Path to signing key relative to $HOME/.ssh (e.g., 'github.pub'). Leave empty to disable signing.
